spawnerwaypoints.config.title: Spawner Waypoints
spawnerwaypoints.config.enabled.desc: Works out the spawners around you from the world seed and shows them as waypoints. When off, the spawners found before are not shown either. To hide the waypoints but keep finding spawners, turn off Show below instead.
spawnerwaypoints.config.dungeonRadius.de: How many chunks around you dungeons are worked out. A larger range takes longer.
How many chunks around you mineshafts, strongholds, nether fortresses, bastions and trial chambers are looked for, for their spawners.
spawnerwaypoints.config.showFrames.desc: Outlines the spawners near you, through walls. A thin outline marks a spawner that may be elsewhere.
spawnerwaypoints.config.frameDistance.de: How far from you spawners are outlined.
